sentence: This project studies how avian influenza virus infection causes metabolic changes in tissues of natural duck hosts and accidental poultry hosts.
This project builds tools to design and create glycomaterials, which are carbohydrate-based polymeric materials.
This project upgrades the network and cybersecurity of a college to improve the security of its data and research.
This project builds molecular tools to control where and when a plant hormone called auxin is made, especially in the root.
This project studies how porphyrin forms a two-dimensional polymer called porphene on a water surface.
This project upgrades wave-propelled autonomous platforms to work in polar oceans and understand how the ocean transfers heat to the atmosphere.
This project builds a method to find out where chert resources came from and how they were distributed through economic networks.
This project builds a software system that helps many specialized computer chips work together to run extremely large artificial intelligence models.
This project builds tools that automatically combine features of tabular data to make better predictions and explain how they were made.
This project measures how small devices leak secret information through power use when running post-quantum cryptography, and builds defenses against it.
This project builds a robotic hand made of micro-fingers moved by laser beams to grasp, move and rotate biological cells.
This project studies whether computer programs can rebuild an electrical circuit from smartphone photographs and find faults in it.
This project studies how autonomous vehicles and human drivers interact in traffic in order to improve safety and energy efficiency.
This project builds machine learning tools that learn from software user interfaces to help with documentation, testing and repairing bugs.
This project uses machine learning to make computer simulations of particle detectors used in neutrino physics run much faster.
This project uses quantum field theory to study how many strongly interacting electrons form states of matter that may help explain high temperature superconductors.
This project works to make quantum simulation of chemistry, materials science and physics problems useful at a large scale.
